direct_claims: This chart shows the share of each country's population living in multidimensional poverty.
The domain is global poverty and human development measurement.
The title states that multidimensional poverty is defined as deprivation across health, education, and living standards indicators.

Cross-country comparisons should be interpreted with some caution because the note says the estimates come from household surveys conducted in different years between 2013 and 2023.
Several countries are marked as having no data rather than a poverty estimate.
The source note mentions that a separate dataset is produced to monitor trends over time.
